mod.help: Settings for the Drop Multiplier mod.

drops.title: Drop Chance
drops.help: How likely enemies are to drop items.

materials.title: Materials
materials.help: How many materials you get from each drop or pickup.

mode.label: Mode
mode.help: Multiply chance: an item's drop chance is multiplied. Fixed chance: every drop is set to one chance.

multiplier.label: Multiplier
multiplier.help: Drop-rate multiplier, used when Mode is Multiply chance. 1 = vanilla, 0 = no drops.

percentage.label: Percentage (%)
percentage.help: Fixed drop chance in percent, used when Mode is Fixed chance. 100 guarantees a drop.

crafting.label: Crafting
crafting.help: Multiplies the crafting materials you get (Rowa Fruit, Herba, bones...). 1 = vanilla.

upgrade.label: Upgrade
upgrade.help: Multiplies the upgrade materials you get (Smithing Stones, Gloveworts...). 1 = vanilla.

unique.label: Unique
unique.help: Multiplies materials found only once (Sacred Tears, Scadutree Fragments...). 1 = vanilla.

log.label: Log file
log.help: Write a log file next to the DLL, for troubleshooting.
